resources.string: Shown while FlipSend stays connected in the background. Hiding this does not hide file transfer notifications.
FlipSend uses this so your paired computer can tap, swipe, and type on this phone after you tap Allow. Viewing the computer does not use this.

Android limits background apps to save battery. Tapping OK opens a system screen where you can select \"Don\'t optimise\" for FlipSend. This keeps the connection alive so your PC can send files and install apps while the phone screen is off. You can undo this in Battery settings at any time.
Open Settings → Apps → FlipSend → Battery → Allow background activity. This stops OxygenOS from closing the connection when the screen is off.
